newsitem.title: ITALY: Specialists bid for 8.0 bln lire of Italy BTPs.
newsitem.headline: Specialists bid for 8.0 bln lire of Italy BTPs.

text.p: Specialist bond traders bid for and were allocated 8.0 billion lire of 10-year fixed-rate bonds (BTP) against the Italian Treasury's offer of 250 billion lire of paper.

Earlier, the Treasury received bids for 5.235 trillion lire at the open auction for a first tranche of the November 1, 2006 paper carrying a 7.75 percent coupon, against 2.5 trillion lire worth of bonds on offer.
The auction price was set at 100.80 from 105.30 at the previous 10-year BTP sale on October 15 when a 15th and final tranche of July 1, 2006, 8.75 percent BTPs was on offer.
